description: Able to read all analog inputs mapped to this group. The group contain both analog sensor signals (ex temperature, pressure, measurements) and internal processed "signals" like blade position etc.

description: Able to read all analog outputs mapped to this group, However analog output are seldom used, and presently only 4 signals are present, and mainly used for test purposed.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.

description: Able to read from the COUN group which contains accumulated values, counts etc. Accumulated energy, hour counters, activity counters (ex number of yawing) are examples of data tags mapped to the COUN group.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.

description: Able to read from the digital input sensor signals that  are mapped to this group. The signals in the DIGI group are directly related to the hardware signal and the TDI naming in the documentation can be used in identifying the signals.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.

description: Able to read from the digital output signals that are mapped to this group. The signals in the DIGO group are directly related to the hardware signal and the TDI naming in the documentation can be used in identifying the signals.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.

description: Able to read from all Design Values. These values are set per design by YourOrg developers only - though information of the value can be of relevance to a broader audience.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.

description: Able to read from the encoders that are mapped into the  ENCR group.  The ENCr group however just contain a few signals in relation to Yaw position.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.

description: Able to read from Filter values that are gathered in this group. The filters are most often based on analog or frequency inputs.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.

description: Able to read from Frequency inputs that are mapped to this group. The group mainly contain  sensor input for RPM (Generator/Rotor/Yaw motor) and wind speed.
role_description: Combination of WPS level 127 and AV tech role.
